high_level_description: stc brand style, a vintage-style televised photograph of a man teaching in a classroom, framed by a TV screen border.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A classroom with a green chalkboard bearing Arabic text in the top right corner, warm sepia-toned lighting, and rounded TV-screen frame corners.

elements.desc: A middle-aged Middle Eastern man wearing glasses, a red and white checkered keffiyeh, a beige button-up shirt, and a gray tweed jacket, holding an open book in his right hand while gesturing with his left.
